title: Louisiana's Starbase Could Flood the Sky with Starships

scenes.text: Louisiana's new Starbase will host ten launch pads
SpaceX filed a plan in 2023 to build up to ten launch sites at the new Starbase in Louisiana.
The complex will also house a large factory to mass‑produce Starship rockets, aiming for weekly flights.
That could boost US launch capacity to over 100 missions a year.
Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Louisiana may become the busiest launch hub on Earth with SpaceX's massive Starbase plan. Follow for daily space breakthroughs!
